mapper.sql: CASE D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN 'WARNING' ELSE D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD END
WHERE D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN = 'N' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd}

WHERE D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N'
AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{selectedDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{selectedDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd}

AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N'
AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{selectedDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{selectedDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('EMERGENCY','HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD = 'SERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SERVICE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETE_NOCS, CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,D.DSBLTY_END_DT) END),0),0) AS SIGNED) AS AVG_RECOVERY_SEC, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) END AS COMPLETE_RATE FROM web_dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN web_eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, COUNT(*) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM web_dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN web_eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY reportDate

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM web_link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN web_eqpmnt_info E ON E.LINK_SYS_CD=L.LINK_SYS_CD AND E.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN web_dsblty_info D ON D.EQPMNT_SN=E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE L.USE_YN='Y' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')

SELECT S.STN_CD AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM com_stn_info S LEFT JOIN web_eqpmnt_info E ON E.STN_CD=S.STN_CD AND E.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN web_dsblty_info D ON D.EQPMNT_SN=E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.MNLS_STN_YN='N' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY S.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,S.STN_SEQ HAVING COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO)>0 ORDER BY S.STN_SEQ

SELECT D.DSBLTY_NO AS dsbltyNo,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm,E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR AS ipAddr, DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ocrnDt, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(A.ACTN_DT) FROM web_dsblty_actn_hstry A WHERE A.DSBLTY_NO=D.DSBLTY_NO AND A.ACTN_SE_CD='TRANSFER'),D.DSBLTY_END_DT),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS transferEndDt, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,COALESCE(D.DSBLTY_END_DT,NOW())) AS durationSec, AS gradeCd,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS faultCn FROM web_dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN web_eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD
ORDER BY D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT DESC LIMIT 500
